For more details refer to our Privacy Policy Previous Seychelles Holidays Overview Trip ideas Best time to visit Things to do Home › Indian Ocean › Seychelles Seychelles The Seychelles, an archipelago of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean, is renowned for its untouched beauty and serene charm. With powdery white beaches, granite boulders, and turquoise waters, it is a dream destination for honeymooners and nature lovers alike. The main islands — Mahé, Praslin, and La Digue — offer a mix of luxury resorts, Creole culture, and lush rainforests. The islands are home to rare wildlife, including giant Aldabra tortoises and unique bird species. With year-round tropical weather, a rich cultural heritage, and pristine surroundings, the Seychelles embodies the essence of an idyllic island paradise. Our most popular trips in Seychelles Seychelles offers travelers a blend of relaxation and adventure. Lounge on iconic beaches like Anse Lazio and Anse Source d’Argent, famous for their striking beauty. Go snorkeling or diving in marine parks such as Sainte Anne or Aldabra Atoll, home to vibrant coral reefs and giant tortoises. Hike through Morne Seychellois National Park on Mahé for lush trails and panoramic views. Visit Vallée de Mai on Praslin, a UNESCO site with the rare coco de mer palm. Explore Creole cuisine in local markets, take island-hopping boat trips, or enjoy sunset cruises. Seychelles offers unforgettable experiences in pure, natural luxury.
